aria.p: Quick sync — Customer ACME asked to accelerate Private deployment by ~3 weeks and wants the V1 feature set (fine-grained routing + audit logs). Our current plan targets MVP (hosted + basic routing, basic observability) for 2026-04-15. Can we negotiate scope or shift milestones? @devin.k @josie.d @matt.c

devin.k: Short answer: we can trade scope for time. Cutting fine-grained routing to a simplified ruleset for MVP saves ~2 engineer-weeks. Audit logs are bigger: KMS/infrastructure gating, roughly 2w infra + 1w app work.

josie.d: Design can produce a pared-down UI for routing (single rule set + canned templates) — saves design + QA time. We can remove tenant-specific RBAC from MVP.

matt.c: FYI from CS: ACME's compliance lead insists on audit logs for their security review. They said they'd accept a letter of attestation + timeline if we can provide a firm target.

aria.p: Options I'm seeing: 
• Option A: Keep MVP date, cut fine-grained routing + RBAC -> ship hosted & Private shell. Audit logs pushed to v1 with commitment date.
• Option B: Delay MVP by 3 weeks to include audit logs and routing in v1 (bigger risk to other customers).
• Option C: Ship MVP earlier with feature-toggles + guaranteed private rollout schedule (customer gets earlier access behind toggles).

Here's a quick milestone snapshot:```
MVP target: 2026-04-15
Option A: MVP 2026-04-15 (no fine-routing, no audit-logs)
Option B: MVP 2026-05-06 (includes audit-logs + routing)
Option C: MVP 2026-04-15 + private toggle for ACME, audit by 2026-05-01
```

devin.k: Implementation notes: Option A = low risk, Option B = highest dev+infra risk, Option C = medium but needs engineering gating & rollout plan (feature flags + canary). If we go C, we need a 1-week expedited QA window and clear rollback plan.

sarah.cs: CS can accept Option C if we get a written commitment and a demo by 2026-04-20. They'll escalate internally to delay compliance sign-off if we hit that demo.

josie.d: For Option C I can ship the simplified UI by 4/8, then we do a 1-week usability pass.

devin.k: Proposed dev schedule for Option C: 
• 3/29–4/8: routing simplified + feature-flag hooks
• 4/9–4/14: QA + security review
• 4/15: soft MVP release (hosted + toggles)
• 4/20: ACME demo behind toggle
• 4/21–5/01: iterate audit-logs work and infra onboarding

aria.p: Decision asked: Are we comfortable committing to Option C (deliver toggles + demo, audit logs follow) so ACME signs? If yes, I'll update roadmap and notify sales/legal. @devin.k @sarah.cs please ack. :eyes:

devin.k: ack — engineering can try Option C but we need final signoff on QA scope.

sarah.cs: ack from CS — will condition acceptance on the 4/20 demo and weekly checkpoint.

deploy-bot: Reminder: daily feature-flagged deploy window scheduled at 02:00 UTC tomorrow for branch/feature/toggles.``
